# Malformed tabs fences should log warn, not abort, and leave the
# surrounding document intact.

md2html -html output -html-ext html testsite
exists output/README.html

# Rendering finishes: the surrounding prose still lands in the page.
grep 'later content' output/README.html

# Malformed blocks are skipped: no tab group markup for the fence.
! grep 'class="md-tabs"' output/README.html
! grep 'role="tabpanel"' output/README.html

# Warnings surface with file + line metadata.
stderr 'tabs: parse error'
stderr 'line=3'
stderr 'file=README.md'
stderr 'requires a group id'

rm -rf testsite output

-- testsite/README.md --
# Heading

::: tabs
::: tab Ubuntu
hello
:::
:::

later content
